title: Single Nuclei RNA Sequencing of Tendon Tissue - small tissue biopsies
author: Adam Cribbs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9sth6en
materials: Pre-cool all solutions and equipment (including centrifuge (+4 o C), homogeniser (+4 o C), dissection Tray (-20 o C), scissors (-20 o C) and scalpel/razor blade (-20 o C)`). All steps in the protocol should be performed on ice or in a cold room (4 o C) to minimise RNA degradation
Proceed to FACS sorting of nuclei.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue on Cold Tray
steps.instruction: Chop the tissue into 4 pieces on a cold dissection tray using scissors and razor blades chilled to -20°C.

substeps.instruction: Use a razor blade to shave off a small piece of tissue.
Cut the tissue into smaller pieces and set aside on the tray.
Use dissection scissors if the tendon is too stringy.

steps.title: Initial Tissue Dissociation
steps.instruction: Pipette the tissue up and down 10 times using a wide bore P1000 tip (with the top of the tip slightly cut off).

steps.title: Primary Homogenization
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to a 7mL or smaller Dounce homogenizer and perform initial homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Add 2-4 mL of NL1 buffer (start with 2 mL and add more if required).
Scrape any remaining tissue from the dissection tray into the Dounce homogenizer using NL1 buffer.
Homogenize the sample using pestle A with 20 strokes.
Place the homogenizer on ice and wait 5 minutes.
Homogenize the sample using pestle B with 20 strokes.

steps.title: First Filtration and Wash
steps.instruction: Filter the sample and perform the first centrifugation wash.

substeps.instruction: Filter the sample into a 50mL Falcon Tube through a 200uM strainer.
Incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge the tube at 500g for 5 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Buffer Exchange to NL2
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in NL2 buffer and filter.

substeps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 4mL of NL2 buffer.
Incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Filter the sample into a 50mL Falcon Tube through a 40uM strainer.

steps.title: Sequential Buffer Washes
steps.instruction: Perform a series of centrifugation and resuspension steps to clean the nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet in 2mL of NW buffer.
Centrifuge at 500g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet in 0.5-1mL of Cell sorting buffer.

steps.title: FACS Purification
steps.instruction: Purify nuclei using a Sony SH800 cell sorter based on FSC and FL3 (due to inability to sort DAPI).

substeps.instruction: Sort nuclei into FACS tubes containing 1mL of NW buffer.

steps.title: Final Nuclei Recovery and Counting
steps.instruction: Concentrate and quantify the purified nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge nuclei at 300g for 10 minutes.
Resuspend in an appropriate volume of NW buffer to achieve a concentration of ~1000 nuclei/uL.
Verify nuclei count using trypan blue and an automatic cell counter if available.

steps.title: Sample Loading
steps.instruction: Load the counted nuclei into a 10X or drop-seq experiment according to the manufacturer's conditions.
